Das Beste deiner Abenteuer ist das, das du noch nicht gesegelt hast!

Dein Zweck

Der Senior Manager für die Produktentwicklung von Schmuck ist dafür verantwortlich, kreative Konzepte in kommerziell erfolgreiche Schmuckkollektionen von MSC Cruises umzuwandeln. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem hauseigenen Schmuckdesigner, dem Head of Watches & Jewelry, Industriepartnern und Lieferanten leitet die Rolle den End-to-End-Produktentwicklungsprozess von der Konzeptvalidierung über die Industrialisierung bis hin zur Markteinführung und stellt sicher, dass jede Kollektion kommerziell ausgewogen, technisch machbar, finanziell tragfähig und auf die Positionierung jeder Kreuzfahrtmarke ausgerichtet ist. Die Rolle vereint Kreativität, Produktkompetenz und industrielles Know-how, um unverwechselbare Schmuckkollektionen zu bauen, die das exklusive Einzelhandelsangebot der Gruppe stärken.

Ihre Wirkung

Sammlungsentwicklung

- Führen Sie die End-to-End-Entwicklung exklusiver Schmuckkollektionen vom Konzept bis zum Launch.

- Übersetzen Sie kreative Visionen in kommerziell erfolgreiche Produkte und bewahren Sie gleichzeitig die Integrität des Designs.

- Erstellen Sie strukturierte Kollektionen mit ausgewogener Produktarchitektur, Preisgestaltung, Materialien und Kundensegmenten.

- Identifizieren Sie Portfoliolücken und schlagen Sie neue Produktmöglichkeiten vor.

- Pflegen Sie die Frische der Kollektion durch saisonale Updates, neue Starts und limitierte Editionen.

Lieferanten- und Industriepartnermanagement

- Finden Sie Lieferanten und verwalten Sie die Beziehungen zu Schmuckherstellern und Produktionspartnern.

- Identifizieren und an Bord neuer Lieferanten, um Wachstum und Innovation zu unterstützen.

- Bewerten Sie Lieferanten auf der Grundlage von Qualität, Handwerk, Innovation, Kapazität, ethischer Beschaffung und Wettbewerbsfähigkeit.

- Erleichterung der technischen Zusammenarbeit zwischen Designern und Herstellern.

- Unterstützen Sie Lieferantenverhandlungen mit der Beschaffung.

Sammlungsarchitektur und Portfoliomanagement

- Bewerten Sie kontinuierlich die Stärke und Vollständigkeit des Modeschmuckportfolios.

- Behalten Sie eine ausgewogene Darstellung über Kategorien, Materialien, Edelsteine, Oberflächen und Preispunkte hinweg bei.

- Analysieren Sie Vertriebs- und Kundeninformationen, um Sortimentsmöglichkeiten zu identifizieren.

- Empfehlen Sie die Rationalisierung des Portfolios, um die Produktivität zu verbessern.

- Entwicklung langfristiger Sammlungs-Roadmaps im Einklang mit der Markenstrategie.

Produktentwicklung

- Verwalten Sie den Produktentwicklungskalender und den kritischen Pfad.

- Koordinieren Sie Prototypen, technische Zeichnungen, Probenahmen, Zulassungen und Produktionsbereitschaft.

- Sicherstellen, dass Produkte Qualität, Kosten, Timing und kommerzielle Ziele erfüllen.

- Überwachen Sie die Produktleistung während des gesamten Lebenszyklus und treiben Sie Verbesserungen voran.

- Die Support-Sammlung wird im gesamten Netzwerk gestartet.

Qualität & Product Excellence

- Stellen Sie sicher, dass alle Produkte Qualitäts-, Regulierungs- und Markenstandards entsprechen.

- Koordinieren Sie Tests, Validierungen und Produktionsgenehmigungen.

- Partnerschaft mit Qualitätsteams, um Probleme zu lösen und die Produktleistung zu verbessern.

- Behalten Sie außergewöhnliche Handwerkskunst in allen Kollektionen.

Funktionale Cross Collaboration

- Partner mit dem Jewelry Designer während des gesamten kreativen Prozesses.

- Richten Sie die Produktentwicklung mit der Kategoriestrategie neben dem Head of Watches & Jewelry aus.

- Arbeiten Sie mit Retail Operations zusammen, um die kommerzielle Ausführung zu maximieren.

- Arbeiten Sie mit Planning and Order Management zusammen, um die Lagerbestände zu optimieren.

- Partnerschaft mit Performance-Teams zur Überwachung von Rentabilität und Anlagerenditen.

- Koordinieren Sie sich effektiv mit funktionsübergreifenden Stakeholdern, um die Ausrichtung und Ausführung sicherzustellen.

Innovation

- Überwachen Sie Schmucktrends, Materialien, Herstellungstechniken und Verbraucherpräferenzen.

- Entdecken Sie neue Materialien, Edelsteine, Oberflächen und Produktionstechnologien.

- Benchmark Wettbewerber und identifizieren Differenzierungsmöglichkeiten.

- Förderung von Innovationen bei gleichzeitiger Aufrechterhaltung der wirtschaftlichen und betrieblichen Lebensfähigkeit.

Deine Reise bisher

- 8+ Jahre Erfahrung in der Schmuckproduktentwicklung, Sammlungsmanagement oder Produktmanagement, idealerweise im zeitgenössischen Schmuckbereich

- Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Schmuckherstellern und Produktionspartnern.

- Starkes Verständnis der Schmuckherstellungsprozesse, Materialien und Handwerkskunst.

- Erfahrung in der Verwaltung von Produktentwicklungskalendern und der Lieferantenkoordination.

- Erfahrung in Luxusschmuck ist sehr wünschenswert.

Ihre Essentials

- Tiefes Verständnis für die Entwicklung von Schmuckprodukten vom Konzept bis zur Produktion.

- Ein fundiertes Wissen über Herstellungstechniken, Materialien und Qualitätsstandards.

- Ausgezeichnetes Projektmanagement und organisatorische Fähigkeiten.

- Kommerzielles Bewusstsein mit der Fähigkeit, Kreativität und Rentabilität auszugleichen.

- Starke analytische Fähigkeiten und Verständnis der Sammlungsarchitektur.

- Hervorragende Kommunikations- und Beziehungsmanagementfähigkeiten.

- Fähigkeit, mehrere Stakeholder über kreative, technische und kommerzielle Funktionen hinweg zu koordinieren.

- Leidenschaft für Luxusschmuck und Produktinnovation.

- Bereitschaft, international zu Lieferanten und Produktionspartnern zu reisen.

Unser Engagement

Wir setzen uns für eine Zukunft ein, die unterschiedliche Perspektiven wertschätzt, die Welt über Grenzen hinaus umfasst und ein integratives Umfeld fördert, in dem sich jeder Mensch geschätzt, respektiert und befähigt fühlt, sein authentisches Selbst zu sein. Votre but

Le directeur principal du développement de produits de bijoux est responsable de la transformation de concepts créatifs en collections de bijoux commercialement réussies à travers MSC Cruises. - Mener la fin au développement de collections de bijoux exclusives du concept au lancement.

- Traduire la vision créative en produits commercialement réussis tout en préservant l'intégrité du design.

- Bâtir des collections structurées avec une architecture de produits équilibrée, des prix, des matériaux et des segments clients.

- Identifier les lacunes du portefeuille et proposer de nouvelles possibilités de produits.

- Maintenir la fraîcheur de la collection par des mises à jour saisonnières, de nouveaux lancements et des éditions limitées.

- Faciliter la collaboration technique entre les concepteurs et les fabricants.

- Appuyer les négociations avec les fournisseurs.

Architecture de collection et gestion de portefeuille

- Évaluer continuellement la force et l'exhaustivité du portefeuille de bijoux de mode.

- Maintenir une représentation équilibrée entre les catégories, les matériaux, les pierres précieuses, les finitions et les prix.

- Analyser les ventes et les points de vue des clients pour identifier les possibilités d'assortiment.

- Recommander la rationalisation du portefeuille pour améliorer la productivité.

- Élaborer des feuilles de route à long terme pour la collecte en harmonie avec la stratégie de la marque.

Développement de produits

- Coordonner les prototypes, les dessins techniques, l'échantillonnage, les approbations et la préparation à la production.

- Veiller à ce que les produits atteignent des objectifs de qualité, de coûts, de calendrier et commerciaux.

- Surveiller la performance des produits tout au long de son cycle de vie et conduire à des améliorations.

- Appuyer les lancements de collecte dans tout le réseau.

- Coordonner les essais, la validation et les approbations de production.

- Partenaire avec des équipes de Qualité pour résoudre les problèmes et améliorer la performance des produits.

- Maintenir un savoir-faire exceptionnel dans toutes les collections.

- Alignez le développement de produits avec la stratégie de catégorie aux côtés de la tête de montres & bijoux.

- Collaborer avec les opérations de vente au détail pour maximiser l'exécution commerciale.

- Travailler avec la planification et la gestion des commandes pour optimiser les niveaux d'inventaire.

- Partenaire avec les équipes Performance pour surveiller la rentabilité et les rendements des investissements.

- Coordonner efficacement avec les intervenants interfonctionnels pour assurer l'alignement et l'exécution.

- Explorez de nouveaux matériaux, pierres précieuses, finitions et technologies de production.

- Repérer les concurrents et identifier les possibilités de différenciation.

- Favoriser l'innovation tout en maintenant la viabilité commerciale et opérationnelle.

- Expérience de travail avec les fabricants de bijoux et les partenaires de production.

- Bonne compréhension des processus de fabrication de bijoux, des matériaux et de l'artisanat.

- Expérience de la gestion des calendriers de développement de produits et de la coordination des fournisseurs.

- L'expérience dans les bijoux de luxe est hautement souhaitable.

- Bonne connaissance des techniques de fabrication, des matériaux et des normes de qualité.

- Excellente gestion de projet et compétences organisationnelles.

- Sensibilisation commerciale avec la capacité d'équilibrer créativité et rentabilité.

- Fortes compétences analytiques et compréhension de l'architecture de collection.

- Excellentes capacités de communication et de gestion des relations.

- Capacité de coordonner plusieurs intervenants à l'échelle des fonctions créatives, techniques et commerciales.

- Passion pour les bijoux de luxe et l'innovation de produits.

- Volonté de se rendre à l'étranger auprès de fournisseurs et de partenaires de fabrication.

- Strong aesthetic sensitivity combined with commercial awareness.

- Excellent knowledge of fashion presentation, styling and luxury retail codes.

Il tuo scopo

- Il ruolo assicura che ogni boutique offre un'esperienza guest premium e coerente nel rispetto dell'identità di ogni marchio di crociera e degli standard visivi dei marchi leader mondiali di lusso e premium.

- Con un particolare focus su Fashion & Accessories, il ruolo coordina anche l'esecuzione visiva delle boutique Orologi & Gioielli e Beauty & Duty Free in stretta collaborazione con partner di marca e team di categoria.

- Lavorando attraverso le funzioni HQ, i team di vendita onboard, gli architetti, i designer e le maison di lusso, Visual Merchandising Manager trasforma le strategie commerciali in ambienti retail ispiranti che massimizzano il coinvolgimento dei clienti e le prestazioni commerciali.

Il tuo impatto

Strategia globale di Visual Merchandising

- Sviluppare e evolvere continuamente la strategia globale di merchandising visivo attraverso MSC Crociere e viaggi Explora.

- Stabilire standard visivi che riflettono il posizionamento di ogni marchio di crociera pur mantenendo l'efficacia commerciale.

- Assicurare la coerenza dell'esecuzione visiva in tutta la flotta globale.

- Sviluppa calendari di merchandising visivo stagionali che supportano iniziative commerciali e lanci di prodotti.

- Creare standard visivi scalabili adattabili a diverse classi di nave e formati boutique.

Moda & Accessori Leadership visiva

- Guida tutte le attività di merchandising visivo per le boutique Fashion & Accessories.

- Sviluppare concetti di visualizzazione che migliorano la narrazione del prodotto e elevare l'esperienza di shopping degli ospiti.

- Ottimizzare la presentazione del prodotto per migliorare la visibilità, la conversione e il valore medio delle transazioni.

- Assicurare che le collezioni siano presentate secondo le migliori pratiche di vendita al dettaglio di lusso mentre si adattano alle realtà operative a bordo.

Orologi, Gioielli e Bellezza Coordinamento

- Coordinate con orologi di lusso, gioielli e marchi di bellezza per garantire l'esecuzione visiva conforme alle linee guida del marchio.

- Gestire l'implementazione di mobili display di marca, materiali di punta di vendita, animazioni e campagne stagionali.

- Coordinate l'installazione di vetrine, display e ambienti di marca durante nuove aperture e ristrutturazioni.

- Agire come il contatto visivo primario merchandising per i team visivi del fornitore.

Esperienza di vendita al dettaglio e viaggio degli ospiti

- Sviluppare esperienze di vendita al dettaglio immersive che incoraggiano la scoperta del prodotto e la narrazione.

- Assicurarsi che la merchandising visiva supporti il viaggio ospiti complessivo in tutti gli spazi di vendita al dettaglio.

- Collabora con Marketing per tradurre campagne in coinvolgendo esperienze in-store.

- Promuovere la vendita al dettaglio esperienziale attraverso animazioni, pop-up, lancio di prodotti e attivazioni stagionali.

Newbuilds & Boutique Development

- Supporta la progettazione al dettaglio per nuove navi, ristrutturazioni e banchine a secco.

- Collabora con architetti, designer e team di Categoria per ottimizzare i layout dei negozi e la presentazione dei prodotti.

- Raccomandare apparecchi, mobili, illuminazione, materiali e soluzioni di visualizzazione allineati con standard di lusso di vendita al dettaglio.

- Partecipare alla messa in servizio e all'apertura della boutique.

Standard di marca & Governance

- Sviluppare e mantenere le linee guida globali per il marketing visivo.

- Condurre controlli regolari della flotta per garantire il rispetto degli standard visivi.

- Identificare opportunità di miglioramento continuo attraverso analisi delle prestazioni e feedback degli ospiti.

- Mantenere forti relazioni con team di merchandising visivi da partner di marca di lusso.

Collaborazione funzionale trasversale

- Collabora a stretto contatto con le operazioni di vendita al dettaglio per massimizzare l'esecuzione commerciale a bordo.

- Lavorare con Gestione Pianificazione e Ordine per garantire la consegna ottimale del materiale VM.

- Partner con Performance per monitorare la redditività della categoria e le prestazioni di investimento.

- Interfaccia con dipartimenti e stakeholder interfunzionali per garantire un coordinamento ottimale, comunicazione, allineamento ed esecuzione in tutta l'organizzazione.

Leadership

- Guidare e sviluppare la funzione Visual Merchandising in tutta l'organizzazione.

- Ispira una cultura della creatività, attenzione ai dettagli e all'eccellenza del lusso.

- Coach onboard campioni visivi e team di vendita al dettaglio su visual merchandising best practice.

- Promuovere l'innovazione garantendo semplicità operativa e coerenza esecutiva.

Il tuo viaggio finora

- 8+ anni di esperienza in Visual Merchandising all'interno di moda di lusso, vendita al dettaglio premium o vendita al dettaglio di viaggio.

- Forte esperienza di lavoro con marchi di lusso e premium riconosciuti a livello internazionale.

- Sperimenta lo sviluppo di standard di merchandising visivo in più negozi o mercati internazionali.

- Esperienza che supporta nuove aperture di negozio e sviluppo di concept retail.

- L'esperienza nei grandi magazzini di lusso, la vendita al dettaglio di moda o la vendita al dettaglio di viaggio è altamente desiderabile.

I tuoi essenziali

- Profonda comprensione dei principi di merchandising visivo di lusso e dell'esperienza del cliente premium.

- Forte sensibilità estetica unita alla consapevolezza commerciale.

- Ottima conoscenza della presentazione della moda, dello stile e dei codici di vendita al dettaglio di lusso.

- Esperienza di collaborazione con marchi di lusso e gestione delle linee guida visive del marchio.

- Forte gestione del progetto e competenze organizzative.

- Ottima capacità di comunicazione e gestione degli stakeholder.

- Capacità di lavorare in ambienti multiculturali e internazionali.

- Mindset creativo supportato da forti capacità di esecuzione.

- Volontà di viaggiare a livello internazionale e navi a bordo regolarmente.

Il nostro impegno

Ci impegniamo a costruire un futuro che valorizza diverse prospettive, abbraccia il mondo oltre i confini, e promuove un ambiente inclusivo in cui ogni individuo si sente valorizzato, rispettato e potenziato per essere il proprio sé autentico. Il nostro impegno si estende a intraprendere azioni significative e misurabili che hanno un impatto positivo a lungo termine sui nostri ospiti, sui nostri dipendenti e sul nostro pianeta.

Pronto a trasformare la tua passione in qualcosa di straordinario? Unisciti a noi a MSC Crociere, dove attendono nuove opportunità. Applicare oggi per essere parte di un team globale che sta spingendo i confini e raggiungere qualcosa di notevole. Il tuo viaggio inizia qui!

- Förderung des experimentellen Einzelhandels durch Animationen, Pop-ups, Produkteinführungen und saisonale Aktivierungen.

jobs.title: Manager, Commercial Performance and Optimisation
jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

The best of your adventures is the one you have yet to sail!

Your Purpose

As Performance and Optimization Manager, you will drive commercial performance across the fleet by transforming complex data into strategic insights and actionable recommendations.

Working closely with Deployment, Revenue Management, Commercial Planning and Finance teams, you will assess the commercial and financial effectiveness of itineraries and deployment strategies, identifying opportunities to maximize revenue, profitability and guest value.
Through advanced analytics and performance evaluation, you will support critical business decisions, uncover growth opportunities and contribute to the continuous optimization of MSC Cruises' commercial strategy in a dynamic and competitive global environment.

Your Impact

- Develop driver-based performance and economic models linking deployment and itinerary choices to revenue potential, operating costs, fuel and emissions, port costs, asset utilization and overall contribution.

- Monitor performance by ship, itinerary, deployment pattern, region and season, using consistent and governed KPIs.

- Identify performance gaps, root causes and quantified optimization opportunities, translating findings into actionable recommendations for deployment and itinerary decisions.

- Develop forward-looking indicators and early-warning mechanisms to identify profitability risks, capacity imbalances and optimization opportunities before they materialize.

- Support scenario evaluation and post-implementation reviews comparing expected vs. realized economic impact and identifying lessons for future deployment decisions.

- Partner with Finance and Revenue Management to ensure consistency of assumptions, metric definitions, attribution methodology and benefit validation.

- Benchmark itinerary and deployment performance across ships, regions and seasons, identifying scalable best practices and structural improvement opportunities.

- Maintain a quantified deployment optimization opportunity pipeline, tracking expected value, ownership, implementation and realized benefits.

- Decision rights: owns KPI definitions and analytical standards; recommends priorities and validates benefits with Finance.

- Core outputs: scorecard, opportunity pipeline, root-cause analyses, test plans, benchmarks and benefit tracking.

- Success measures: incremental revenue or margin, conversion and spend improvement, forecast accuracy, action closure and adoption.

Your Journey so far

- Degree in Economics, Finance, Business Analytics, Hospitality, Marketing or related field.

- 5-8 years of relevant commercial analytics, revenue management, onboard revenue, performance improvement

- Strong Power BI experience

- Strong understanding of guest behavior, revenue drivers, conversion, yield and service profitability.

- Proven ability to turn analysis into interventions and validate financial impact.

- Fluent English.

Your Essentials

- Advanced SQL, business intelligence, statistical analysis or comparable tools.

- Python advantageous.

- Swiss national or right to work in Switzerland is mandatory.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

Attraverso analisi avanzate e la valutazione delle prestazioni, supporterai le decisioni aziendali critiche, scoprirai le opportunità di crescita e contribuirai all'ottimizzazione continua della strategia commerciale di MSC Crociere in un ambiente globale dinamico e competitivo.

Il tuo impatto

- Sviluppare prestazioni basate sui driver e modelli economici che collegano le scelte di distribuzione e di itinerario a potenziali ricavi, costi operativi, carburante e emissioni, costi portuali, utilizzo degli asset e contributo complessivo.

- Monitorare le prestazioni per nave, itinerario, schema di distribuzione, regione e stagione, utilizzando KPI coerenti e regolati.

- Identificare le lacune delle prestazioni, le cause principali e le opportunità di ottimizzazione quantificate, traducendo i risultati in raccomandazioni attuabili per le decisioni di implementazione e di itinerario.

- Sviluppare indicatori previsionali e meccanismi di allarme precoce per identificare i rischi di redditività, gli squilibri di capacità e le opportunità di ottimizzazione prima di concretizzare.

- Valutazione dello scenario di supporto e recensioni post-implementazione che comparano l'impatto economico previsto vs. realizzato e l'identificazione di lezioni per le decisioni future di distribuzione.

- Partner con Finance e Revenue Management per garantire la coerenza delle ipotesi, delle definizioni metriche, della metodologia di attribuzione e della validazione dei benefici.

- Benchmark itinerario e performance di distribuzione su navi, regioni e stagioni, individuando best practice scalabili e opportunità di miglioramento strutturale.

- Mantenere una pipeline di ottimizzazione di distribuzione quantificata, tracciare valore atteso, proprietà, implementazione e vantaggi realizzati.

- Diritti di decisione: possiede definizioni KPI e standard analitici; raccomanda priorità e convalida i benefici con la finanza.

- Risultati principali: scorecard, opportunità pipeline, analisi, piani di test, benchmark e monitoraggio dei benefici.

- Misure di successo: ricavi o margini incrementali, conversione e passi miglioramento, precisione delle previsioni, chiusura delle azioni e adozione.

Il tuo viaggio finora

- Laurea in Economia, Finanza, Business Analytics, Ospitalità, Marketing o relativo campo.

- 5-8 anni di analisi commerciale rilevante, gestione delle entrate, entrate a bordo, miglioramento delle prestazioni

- Esperienza potente BI

- Forte comprensione del comportamento degli ospiti, dei driver di reddito, della conversione, della resa e della redditività del servizio.

- Prove capacità di trasformare l'analisi in interventi e convalidare l'impatto finanziario.

- Inglese fluente.

I tuoi essenziali

- SQL avanzato, business intelligence, analisi statistica o strumenti comparabili.

- Python vantaggioso.

- Il diritto di lavorare in Svizzera è obbligatorio.

Il nostro impegno

Ci impegniamo a costruire un futuro che valorizza diverse prospettive, abbraccia il mondo oltre i confini, e promuove un ambiente inclusivo in cui ogni individuo si sente valorizzato, rispettato e potenziato per essere il proprio sé autentico. Il nostro impegno si estende a intraprendere azioni significative e misurabili che hanno un impatto positivo a lungo termine sui nostri ospiti, sui nostri dipendenti e sul nostro pianeta.

Pronto a trasformare la tua passione in qualcosa di straordinario? Unisciti a noi a MSC Crociere, dove attendono nuove opportunità. Applicare oggi per essere parte di un team globale che sta spingendo i confini e raggiungere qualcosa di notevole. Il tuo viaggio inizia qui!

- Category

- Brand

- Fournir une analyse régulière du rendement en :

- Navire

- Boutique

- Catégorie

- Marque

- SK

- Itinéraire

- Taux de conversion

- Unités par transaction (UPT)

- Vente par mètre carré / espace de vente

- Vente

- Marge brute

- Productivité des stocks

- Tour du stock

- Analyser les tendances des ventes, la saisonnalité, l'impact de l'itinéraire et le comportement des clients pour améliorer les prévisions.

- Identifier les meilleures ventes, les mouvements lents et les risques d'inventaire.

- Fournir des recommandations concernant:

- Montant alloué

- Rétablissement

- Équilibre des stocks

- Optimisation des stocks

- Soutenir la prévention des pénuries de stocks et la saisie des possibilités.

- Soutenir la validation des prix et la cohérence des prix entre les catégories.

- Analyser les performances promotionnelles et l'efficacité de la notation.

- Soutenir la budgétisation annuelle, les prévisions et la gouvernance ouverte à l'achat.

- Évaluer la rentabilité par:

- Produit

- Analyser:

- Productivité des produits

- Contribution SKU

- Résultats de la collecte

- Performance de la marque

- Architecture des prix

- Déterminer les possibilités d'améliorer la profondeur et l'efficacité de l'assortiment.

- Soutenir les examens saisonniers de l'assortiment et les décisions d'achat.

- Surveiller la santé de l'inventaire dans toute la flotte.

- Identifier :

- Situation de surstockage

- Manque de stocks

- Inventaire obsolète

- Produits à faible productivité

- Recommander des mesures pour améliorer le rendement des stocks et l'efficacité de la trésorerie.

- Mesures de soutien et décisions de liquidation au besoin.

Gestion des données et outils

- Partenaire avec les équipes IT et Digital pour améliorer la disponibilité des données de détail et les capacités de rapport.

- Soutenir le développement de futurs systèmes de détail et de solutions analytiques.

- Assurer l'exactitude, la cohérence et la gouvernance des données.

- Contribuer à la transition des rapports manuels basés sur Excel vers l'analyse automatisée.

- Gestionnaires de catégorie

- Commerce de détail

- Planification des marchandises

- Financement

- Chaîne d'approvisionnement

- Équipes informatiques / numériques

- Agir en tant que partenaire analytique de confiance appuyant les décisions commerciales

Your Purpose

The Head of Watches & Jewelry Product Category is the global business owner for the Watches & Jewelry category across MSC Cruises and Explora Journeys.

The role is responsible for defining and executing the global category strategy, driving commercial performance, developing a world-class assortment, and building long-term partnerships with leading watch and jewelry maisons.

Working closely with Retail Operations, Planning & Budget, and Supply Chain, this role ensures the category delivers exceptional guest experiences while maximizing sales, profitability and brand equity across all ships.

The position combines strategic category management with strong commercial leadership to continuously elevate the onboard retail offering across both contemporary and luxury environments.

Your Impact

Category Strategy & Business Ownership

- Own the global Watches & Jewelry category strategy across MSC Cruises and Explora Journeys.

- Define the long-term category vision aligned with the commercial objectives and positioning of each cruise brand.

- Identify emerging trends, market opportunities and guest expectations to continuously evolve the category.

- Build a balanced portfolio across fine jewelry, fashion jewelry, luxury watches, contemporary watches and exclusive collections.

- Develop category roadmaps supporting future fleet expansion, new concepts and new brand introductions.

Commercial Performance

- Deliver category sales, gross margin and profitability targets.

- Monitor category performance through KPI analysis, identifying opportunities and corrective actions.

- Optimize product mix, pricing architecture, promotional activities and inventory productivity.

- Lead forecasting and assortment planning in collaboration with Demand Planning and Order Management teams.

- Drive continuous improvement of productivity per SKU, per brand, per boutique and per vessel.

Product Development & Assortment Management

- Curate compelling assortments adapted to guest demographics, regions, itineraries and ship profiles.

- Develop exclusive products, capsule collections and cruise-only editions with strategic partners.

- Manage the full product lifecycle from selection and onboarding to phase-out.

- Ensure assortment reflects market trends while preserving a coherent brand architecture.

- Balance innovation with proven commercial performers.

Brand Partnerships

- Develop and manage relationships with global watch and jewelry brands.

- Lead commercial negotiations including trading terms, exclusivities, product launches and joint business plans.

- Identify and onboard new brands aligned with the Group retail strategy.

- Coordinate supplier performance reviews and continuous business development initiatives.

- Represent MSC Group during industry events, trade fairs and partner meetings.

Merchandising & Retail Excellence

- Define merchandising guidelines specific to the Watches & Jewelry category.

- Collaborate with Visual Merchandising to create premium boutique experiences that enhance conversion and storytelling.

- Support newbuilds, refurbishments and boutique redesigns from a category perspective.

- Ensure collections are presented according to luxury brand standards and visual excellence.

- Partner with onboard teams to continuously improve category execution.

Cross Functional Collaboration

- Partner closely with Retail Operations to maximize onboard commercial execution.

- Work with Planning and Order Management to ensure optimal inventory availability while minimizing excess stock.

- Partner with Performance to monitor category profitability and investment performance.

- Interface with cross-functional departments and stakeholders to ensure optimal coordination, communication, alignment and execution across the organization.

Leadership

- Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration and commercial excellence.

- Coach team members and support succession planning.

- Encourage data-driven decision making while maintaining strong customer and brand focus.

Your Journey so far

- 10+ years of experience in luxury watches and/or jewelry merchandising.

- Proven success managing international product categories within luxury retail, travel retail or omnichannel environments.

- Strong experience in assortment planning, buying, supplier negotiations and category management.

- Experience working with internationally recognized watch and jewelry brands.

- Experience in luxury retail or travel retail environments is highly desirable

Your Essentials

- Deep understanding of luxury watches and jewelry markets, trends and consumer behavior.

- Strong commercial and financial acumen with excellent analytical skills.

- Proven ability to negotiate and build long-term strategic supplier partnerships.

- Excellent understanding of merchandising principles, assortment architecture and inventory optimization.

- Strong project management and organizational skills.

- Ability to work across multicultural and international environments.

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

- Passion for luxury retail and delivering exceptional guest experiences.

- Willingness to travel internationally.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

Working closely with Retail Operations, Planning & Budget, and Supply Chain, this role ensures the category delivers exceptional guest experiences while maximizing sales, profitability and brand equity across all ships.

The position combines strategic category management with strong commercial leadership to continuously elevate the onboard retail offering across both contemporary and luxury environments.

Your Impact

Category Strategy & Business Ownership

- Own the global Watches & Jewelry category strategy across MSC Cruises and Explora Journeys.

- Define the long-term category vision aligned with the commercial objectives and positioning of each cruise brand.

- Identify emerging trends, market opportunities and guest expectations to continuously evolve the category.

- Build a balanced portfolio across fine jewelry, fashion jewelry, luxury watches, contemporary watches and exclusive collections.

- Develop category roadmaps supporting future fleet expansion, new concepts and new brand introductions.

- Deliver category sales, gross margin and profitability targets.

- Monitor category performance through KPI analysis, identifying opportunities and corrective actions.

- Optimize product mix, pricing architecture, promotional activities and inventory productivity.

- Lead forecasting and assortment planning in collaboration with Demand Planning and Order Management teams.

- Drive continuous improvement of productivity per SKU, per brand, per boutique and per vessel.

- Curate compelling assortments adapted to guest demographics, regions, itineraries and ship profiles.

- Develop exclusive products, capsule collections and cruise-only editions with strategic partners.

- Manage the full product lifecycle from selection and onboarding to phase-out.

- Ensure assortment reflects market trends while preserving a coherent brand architecture.

- Balance innovation with proven commercial performers.

- Develop and manage relationships with global watch and jewelry brands.

- Lead commercial negotiations including trading terms, exclusivities, product launches and joint business plans.

- Identify and onboard new brands aligned with the Group retail strategy.

- Coordinate supplier performance reviews and continuous business development initiatives.

- Represent MSC Group during industry events, trade fairs and partner meetings.

- Define merchandising guidelines specific to the Watches & Jewelry category.

- Collaborate with Visual Merchandising to create premium boutique experiences that enhance conversion and storytelling.

- Support newbuilds, refurbishments and boutique redesigns from a category perspective.

- Ensure collections are presented according to luxury brand standards and visual excellence.

- Partner with onboard teams to continuously improve category execution.

- Partner closely with Retail Operations to maximize onboard commercial execution.

- Work with Planning and Order Management to ensure optimal inventory availability while minimizing excess stock.

- Partner with Performance to monitor category profitability and investment performance.

- Interface with cross-functional departments and stakeholders to ensure optimal coordination, communication, alignment and execution across the organization.

Leadership

- Lead and develop the Watches & Jewelry merchandising team.

- Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration and commercial excellence.

- Coach team members and support succession planning.

- Encourage data-driven decision making while maintaining strong customer and brand focus.

- 10+ years of experience in luxury watches and/or jewelry merchandising.

- Proven success managing international product categories within luxury retail, travel retail or omnichannel environments.

- Strong experience in assortment planning, buying, supplier negotiations and category management.

- Experience working with internationally recognized watch and jewelry brands.

- Experience in luxury retail or travel retail environments is highly desirable

Your Essentials

- Deep understanding of luxury watches and jewelry markets, trends and consumer behavior.

- Strong commercial and financial acumen with excellent analytical skills.

- Proven ability to negotiate and build long-term strategic supplier partnerships.

jobs.title: Consumer Communications Director
jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

Discover your journey into the extraordinary.

Your Purpose

Explora Journeys is a vibrant, cosmopolitan, European luxury brand, imagined in the heart of Swiss hospitality in Geneva. Leveraging our parent company MSC Group’s hundreds of years of maritime expertise, our fleet of six luxury ships (three currently in the pipeline) are being built and designed in a totally different and unique way that will transform and redefine the cruise experience, creating a category of its own, appealing to the next generation of luxury travellers.

An exciting opportunity exists for an accomplished editorial and marketing leader to join our newly created luxury travel brand Explora Journeys, based in our offices in Geneva, Switzerland.

We are seeking a highly skilled and Gen-AI savvy Consumer Communications Director to shape how our brand is experienced through language. This is a strategic leadership role responsible for delivering a distinctive, consistent, and elevated brand voice across all content, overseeing copy development with final editorial responsibility, and driving impactful onboard marketing that elevates the guest experience and drives commercial performance.

Your Impact

- Editorial leadership & tone of voice: Establish and own the brand editorial standard. Translate complex hospitality offerings into clear, emotionally engaging messaging that elevates perceived value. Bring a talent for making the long or unclear short, simple and impactful, ensuring every word reflects the elegance, warmth and exclusivity of a luxury hospitality brand with a consistent tone of voice. Maintain copy frameworks, messaging guidelines, and tone-of-voice documentation.

- Creative writing and storytelling at scale: Lead the development of clear, compelling and brand-aligned copy across all channels and touchpoints. Oversee and write high-quality content including brand stories, destination narratives and hospitality experiences, subsequently scaling this across channels and audiences, meeting the specific requirements of each touchpoint.

- Editorial responsibility and proofreading: Establish rigorous quality standards and processes and personally sign off every single piece of consumer-facing copy to meet the brand’s editorial standards, ensuring clarity, grammatical accuracy and stylistic consistency, adjusted for differentiated channels, audiences and situations.

- Onboard marketing: Lead the onboard marketing team, owning content and copy strategy, ensuring all communication enhances the guest experience and supports the delivery of onboard revenue targets. Develop clear and compelling messaging across onboard channels including e.g. printed in-suite materials, digital screens, App content and in-suite TV content.

- Copywriter network management: oversee and continuously optimise the external copywriter network, ensuring consistent quality, speed, cost efficiency and flexible capacity to meet business needs. Brief and guide copywriters to deliver consistent messaging and tone of voice, with content tailored to each channel and audience. Proactively manage the resource and supplier mix, bringing in new talent and capabilities where required and transitioning out suppliers that no longer meet business needs. Maintain a scalable network that can adapt to changing priorities and accommodate significant, periodic increases in volume without compromising quality or timely delivery.

- AI amplification to deliver scale and speed: use and champion the responsible use of Gen-AI and emerging tools to increase creative scale, speed and efficiency across the copy lifecycle—from ideation and drafting to editing, adaptation and optimisation. Combine technology with impeccable human taste, editorial judgment and brand stewardship to ensure AI-enabled content consistently meets brand standards.

Your Journey so far

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in journalism, communications, English, media or a related field

- 10+ years of editorial, copywriting, journalism, communications or brand storytelling experience, with substantial exposure to travel, cruise, luxury or destination content

- Native English speaker a non-negotiable must, native British English speaker strongly preferred

Your Essentials

- Exceptional command of English writing, editing, and proofreading.

- Outstanding leadership, coaching and people development skills. Excellent collaboration and influencing skills, with proven ability to navigate a matrix organisation. Structured, well organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple projects, thriving in a fast-paced, start-up environment. Proven ability to roll-up your sleeves and execute with excellence.

- Excellent storytelling skills, with a refined aesthetic sensibility and understanding of luxury brand positioning. A strong portfolio demonstrating sophisticated, persuasive, and brand-sensitive copy.

- Demonstrated flexibility to adapt content for different audiences (e.g. B2B vs B2C) and different channels (e.g. Press releases, speeches, Customer Service FAQs, In-suite letters, with proven experience writing for digital platforms) while maintaining brand integrity.

- Proven experience prompting AI tools and creating AI agents for ideation, content creation, and editing to augment capacity and increase output, while keeping strong editorial judgment over final copy

- Familiarity with GEO & SEO copywriting principles

- Deep appreciation for luxury hospitality, travel experiences, and high-end service culture. Passion and curiosity to continuously learn about the ever evolving and luxury travel industry.

- Self-learner, continuously testing and learning with creative technologies and AI-assisted workflows.

At Explora Journeys, we are redefining luxury ocean travel — where discovery, well-being, and a deep respect for the seas come together in harmony.
We seek passionate professionals who share our vision of a more immersive, transformative way to discover the world’s most inspiring destinations by sea.
Are you ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at Explora Journeys, where an ocean of opportunities awaits. Your journey to the Ocean State of Mind starts here.

jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

The best of your adventures is the one you have yet to sail!

Your Purpose

Are you passionate about shaping extraordinary private destinations where design, nature, and hospitality come together to create unforgettable guest experiences?

Do you bring hands-on expertise in theme parks, resorts, or island experiences and the analytical mindset to transform complex operational challenges into seamless, high-impact holiday moments?

Your Impact

MSC Cruises is seeking a Sr Director of Product Innovation with expertise in hospitality, F&B and resort development. In this role, you will define the future of engaging, imaginative, and operationally feasible destinations. You will combine strategic insight, creative thinking, and operational expertise to design environments that delight our guests.

You’ll partner closely with brand, development, design, technical, and operational teams to translate complex requirements into actionable plans. Using operational insights, industry trends, and sustainable development principles, you will shape concepts that balance feasibility, innovation, and guest experience.

If you thrive at the intersection of strategy, analytics, and operational leadership and enjoy turning visionary concepts into tangible, memorable holiday experiences, we’d love to hear from you.

Your Journey so far

- Lead the ideation and conceptual development of private destinations, defining objectives, master planning, operational parameters, and technical constraints.

- Collaborate with design, development, operations, F&B, logistics, and technical teams to translate vision into clear, actionable plans.

- Analyse operational insights, industry trends, guest expectations, and competitive offerings to guide concept refinement, decision-making, and KPI setting.

- Engage and align multiple stakeholders across regions, providing guidance on priorities, feasibility, and strategic objectives.

- Contribute to long-term roadmaps for private destinations and resort experiences, ensuring alignment with brand vision and guest experience goals.

- Prepare compelling presentations and documentation to communicate rationale, operational requirements, and recommendations to senior leadership.

- Ensure all proposed concepts adhere to health, safety, environmental, and regulatory standards.

Your Essentials

- 10-15 years of experience in experiential design, destination/resort management with port/cruise operations management a plus.

- Strong operational knowledge of cruise industry logistics, hotel development, port operations, and technical requirements.

- Ability to translate complex operational and technical requirements into clear, actionable concepts.

- Understanding of architectural, design, or engineering principles is a plus.

- Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to coordinate and align cross-functional and multicultural teams.

- Strategic thinker with strong analytical skills; able to assess feasibility, operational impact, and guest experience implications.

- Strong communication and presentation skills, able to convey complex ideas to senior and executive leadership.

- Agile, adaptable, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

- Passion for delivering operationally feasible, guest-focused innovations.

- Proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.

-
• Ability to travel 20–30% of the time.

-
• Fluent English; additional languages a plus.

-
• EU Passport or right to work in Switzerland.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!
